title: Twisted factorial Grothendieck polynomials and equivariant $K$-theory of weighted Grassmann orbifolds
summary: In this paper, we provide an explicit description of the Schubert classes in the equivariant $K$-theory of weighted Grassmann orbifolds. We introduce the `twisted factorial Grothendieck polynomials', a family of symmetric polynomials by specializing the factorial Grothendieck polynomials, and prove that they represent the Schubert classes in the equivariant $K$-theory of the weighted Grassmann orbifolds.
